The main takeaway from our work is that
EPM2B and STBD1 are not involved in PD pathology.
Stbd1 deficiency is the only one of the four genes that we have investigated to significantly reduce total glycogen levels in the lysosomes.
Stbd1 deficiency is the most effective in decreasing lysosomal glycogen content, and thus could be a viable target for PD treatment.
